title: Pontotoc Apostolic Church seeks vendors for its Dec. 5 Christmas craft fair
excerpt: The church is inviting local makers and bakers to its first Christmas craft fair. Vendors can call 662-308-0094 about space, fees and setup.
locality: Pontotoc, Mississippi, as given in the event listing. The listing gives no street venue.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Apostolic Church is inviting local makers and bakers to reserve space for its first Christmas Craft Fair on Saturday, Dec. 5. The church’s flyer lists 662-308-0094 for information about vendor registration.
Vendors must pay a fee, and the flyer describes space as limited. Organizers say shoppers can expect handmade gifts, decorations and holiday treats. Children’s activities are also planned.

Anyone planning to set up a booth or arrive early should check the time and location with the organizer. The church’s flyer says doors open at 8 a.m., while the online listing gives a 10 a.m. start and identifies the venue only as Pontotoc. Vendors can use the same number to ask about the fee and setup time.
